title: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23053v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) have emerged as promising approaches to robot learning and control. These models integrate multimodal perception and action generation, but differ in their architectures, output representations, and learning objectives. In this paper, we present a unified, architecture-agnostic probabilistic formulation for embodied foundation models based on stochastic kernels. Our formulation has two key components: (i) we characterize embodied foundation models through conditional output distributions and action-realization kernels, which together induce task-conditioned robot policies; and (ii) we connect pretraining and post-training to policy deployment, accommodating model-specific pretraining objectives and offline or online post-training strategies. We instantiate the formulation for OpenVLA and DreamZero, covering autoregressive action-token prediction and joint video-action g

translated_title: 通过“模型到策略”的公式化表述统一具身基础模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAM）已成为机器人学习与控制领域颇具前景的方法。这些模型融合了多模态感知与动作生成，但在架构、输出表示和学习目标上各不相同。本文提出了一种基于随机核的、与具体架构无关的统一概率表述，用于刻画具身基础模型。我们的表述包含两个关键组成部分：（i）通过条件输出分布和动作实现核来刻画具身基础模型，二者共同导出任务条件化的机器人策略；（ii）将预训练与后训练连接到策略部署，从而兼容模型特定的预训练目标以及离线或在线的后训练策略。我们在OpenVLA和DreamZero上对该表述进行了实例化，涵盖自回归动作token预测与联合视频-动作生成（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机核的、与架构无关的统一概率表述，将VLA模型与世界动作模型等具身基础模型纳入“模型到策略”的统一框架，贯通预训练、后训练与策略部署全过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified, architecture-agnostic probabilistic formulation based on stochastic kernels that bridges vision-language-action models and world-action models under a model-to-policy framework, connecting pretraining, post-training, and policy deployment.
